request.deadline: Contract year covering 52 weeks, with architecture assessment by Q3 2027 and IOG contract stated as closing August 31, 2026
deliverables: Protocol maintenance, node upgrades, hard fork readiness, and compatible releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support and support for newer hardware wallet models as they emerge
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus
Japanese localisation and Japanese-language user support
Ongoing user support through GitHub, community forums, and direct channels
Security and dependency maintenance for Electron, Node.js, wallet dependencies, Nix build infrastructure, and platform compatibility
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect administration and project-specific smart contract arrangements
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027, delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, while the true count is asserted to be higher because privacy-conscious users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped items including Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, Nix modernization, and Daedalus 8.0 and 11.0.
The proposal commits to compatible Daedalus releases at least 2 weeks before every mainnet hard fork, with development builds on relevant testnets and all four platform builds maintained.
The funded scope includes maintaining Daedalus security and dependencies, preserving auditable local key generation, storage, and signing, and keeping releases reproducibly buildable through Nix.

All funded outputs are described as public assets under the Apache License 2.0, with Se7en Labs claiming no subscription revenue, customer relationship capture, token value, or IP exclusivity from the work.

The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, comprising 1,666,667 ADA for maintenance and improvements, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and 52,000 ADA for Intersect administration.
The proposal states that any unspent labor, hardware, and audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
The proposal states that release timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds, verify milestones, use treasury management smart contracts, disburse monthly against verified work, and provide oversight through an external committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for a 2026-2027 time-and-materials engagement to maintain and improve Daedalus, emphasizing hard fork readiness, full-node wallet security, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, user support, public-good licensing, and Intersect-administered milestone oversight.
